does: Lifts off the foam and fat that rise to the top of a simmering liquid, so that it stays clear and tastes clean.

intro.what: Skimming lifts foam and fat from the surface of a gently simmering liquid.
intro.why: It teaches you to remove what collects on top without stirring it back through a stock.

how: Bring the pot up slowly. The grey foam rises as it nears a simmer.
Hold a ladle flat, just under the surface, and let the foam flow into it.
Move the pot half off the heat, so that the foam gathers on the cooler side.
Skim often at the start, then now and then as fat collects.

cues.text: A clear surface with a few bright beads of fat and no grey foam.

mistakes.mistake: Letting the pot boil before skimming, which churns the foam and fat back in and clouds the liquid for good.
mistakes.fix: Keep it at a bare simmer and skim as soon as foam appears.
Leave it still. Stirring spreads through the liquid what was rising to be skimmed.

quiz.question: What do you remove when skimming a stock?
choices: Foam and fat that rise to the surface.
The clear liquid just beneath the foam.
Solids strained from the entire liquid through a sieve.
quiz.because: Foam and fat rise to the surface, where you can lift them away from the liquid.

quiz.question: How do you position the ladle to skim the surface?
choices: Deep in the bottom of the pot.
Tilted deep into the liquid to scoop from below the foam.
quiz.because: A flat ladle held just below the surface lets the foam flow into it.

quiz.question: Which surface shows the result you want after skimming?
choices: Foam churned throughout a rolling boil.
A clear surface without grey foam.
quiz.because: A surface without grey foam shows the result of skimming. A few bright beads of fat may still remain.

quiz.question: Stirring is spreading the foam through the stock. What should you change?
choices: Leave it still and lift foam gently from the surface.
Continue stirring until the foam is too fine to see.
Bring it to a rolling boil before skimming.
quiz.because: Stirring spreads through the stock what was rising to the surface. Leave it still and skim gently.

comes_after.why: Skimming only works on a pot held at a simmer.
